map.输入噪音等级、轴承转速与工况条件，评估低噪音轴承设计的保持寿命: Enter noise level, bearing speed and service conditions to assess the holding life of low-noise bearing design
map.低噪音寿命评估：基于初始噪音等级、限值、轴承转速/类型/润滑与载荷，参照噪音衰减: Low-noise life assessment: based on initial noise level, limit, bearing speed / type / lubrication and load, estimate the compliant life with reference to the noise attenuation model, for low-noise equipment selection.
map.💡 噪音增长率 = k×转速^0.5×载荷因子；低噪音寿命 = (限值-初始): Noise growth rate = k times sqrt(speed) times load factor; low-noise life = (limit minus initial) / growth rate
map.低噪音轴承初始噪音通常 25-35 dB，普通轴承 40-50 dB: Low-noise bearing initial noise is usually 25-35 dB, ordinary bearing 40-50 dB
map.噪音每增加 3 dB，人耳感知约增加一倍: Every 3 dB increase in noise roughly doubles human perception
map.润滑不良是噪音增长加速的主要原因: Poor lubrication is the main cause of accelerated noise growth
map.📚 深度解析：低噪音寿命评估（噪音增长率与保持寿命）: In-depth: Low-Noise Life Assessment (noise growth rate and holding life)
map.：估算噪音升至限值前可保持的小时数: : estimate the hours the noise can be held below the limit
map.润滑方案对比：脂/油/油雾润滑对噪音增长的影响: Lubrication scheme comparison: effect of grease / oil / oil mist lubrication on noise growth
map.工况优化：评估降速、减载对低噪音寿命的提升: Condition optimization: evaluate the improvement of low-noise life by reducing speed and load
map.算法：载荷因子 = (载荷/500)^0.3；噪音增长率 = 0.0008×√转: Algorithm: load factor = (load / 500) to the 0.3; noise growth rate = 0.0008 times sqrt(speed) times load factor times type factor times lubrication factor (dB/h; bearing type deep groove ball 1, angular contact 1.2, cylindrical roller 1.5; lubrication grease 1, oil 0.7, oil mist 0.5); noise margin = limit minus initial noise; low-noise life = margin / growth rate (h, lower bound 1 h); equivalent revolutions = life times 60 times speed; annualized = life / 8760; monthly growth = growth rate times 24 times 30 (dB/month); greater than or equal to 20000 h excellent, greater than or equal to 10000 h good, greater than or equal to 5000 h medium, otherwise poor.
map.例：深沟球轴承、脂润滑、初始 35dB、限值 45dB、3000rpm、500N: Example: deep groove ball bearing, grease lubrication, initial 35 dB, limit 45 dB, 3000 rpm, 500 N gives load factor 1, growth rate 0.043818 dB/h, margin 10 dB, low-noise life 228.2 h, equivalent revolutions 4.108e7, monthly growth 31.55 dB, rated poor. Switch to oil mist lubrication, initial 30 dB, limit 50 dB, 1500 rpm, 300 N gives load factor 0.758, growth rate 0.013291 dB/h, life rises to 1504.8 h, monthly growth 9.57 dB. It shows lubrication method and speed are the two most effective levers.
map.为什么算出来的寿命偏短？: Why is the computed life rather short?
map.模型基础系数 k=0.0008 偏保守，且噪音限值通常只留 10dB 余量。它适: The model base coefficient k = 0.0008 is conservative, and the noise limit usually leaves only 10 dB margin. It is suitable for relative comparison between schemes, not as an absolute life commitment; to get an absolute value, the k should be calibrated with measured noise growth curves.
map.润滑方式影响为什么这么大？: Why does the lubrication method matter so much?
map.油雾润滑因子 0.5、油润滑 0.7，相比脂润滑可显著抑制磨粒与贫油导致的噪音上: Oil mist lubrication factor 0.5, oil lubrication 0.7, compared with grease lubrication can significantly suppress noise rise caused by abrasive particles and oil starvation, while removing heat; the cost is the need for an oil supply system and oil mist treatment.
map.关于「低噪音寿命评估」: About the Low-Noise Life Assessment tool
map.低噪音寿命评估工具输入初始噪音等级、噪音限值、轴承转速与载荷，基于噪音增长速率模: The low-noise life assessment tool inputs initial noise level, noise limit, bearing speed and load, estimates the holding life of low-noise bearings before noise exceeds the limit based on the noise growth rate model, comprehensively considering bearing type and lubrication method, providing reference for low-noise bearing selection and maintenance.
map.基于噪音增长速率的寿命预测模型: Life prediction model based on noise growth rate

map.计算噪音余量与月增长率: Compute noise margin and monthly growth rate
map.输出低噪音等级与维护建议: Output low-noise grade and maintenance suggestions
map.电机、主轴噪音寿命评估: Motor and spindle noise life assessment
